body: NEW CALL SITE of the lasting reachability answer (P2-22, 6 Nov 2026, branch task/P2-22-keep-app-lines). The lines under a download ("... waiting for your server") read `serverAwayProvider` through ONE provider, `phoneWaitProvider` (app/lib/features/downloads/download_line_providers.dart), together with the network kind and the Wi-Fi-only setting. It adds no new notion of "can I reach my server". When P1-17 replaces the eleven with one state, change `phoneWaitProvider` to read that state; it has a test (download_line_providers_test.dart, "the phone's reason is the same test the strip uses").
